## Current Role

**Nordic Operations Manager — Nordcloud, an IBM Company** (October 2025 – Present)

Sole operational lead for IBM's 5 Nordic offices: Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Copenhagen, and Oslo. Full P&L accountability including budget forecasting, cost-reduction initiatives, vendor contract negotiations, and sustainability-aligned procurement strategy. Central bridge between Nordic C-suite, IBM global management, and external suppliers across a multi-country enterprise footprint. Key operational lead for Nordcloud–IBM legal entity integration (effective 2026-07-01).

## Skills & Expertise

Barbora Perinajová manages complex operations across multiple countries and cultural contexts. Her operational expertise centres on P&L ownership for five Nordic offices across Sweden, Denmark, and Norway, encompassing budget forecasting, vendor contract negotiations, procurement strategy, digital case management, and business continuity planning. She introduced a digital case management system that reduced duplicate work by 60% and designed a 200-file document framework cited as exemplary in an internal IBM audit.

In sustainability and policy, Barbora works at the intersection of EU climate governance and organisational practice. Her expertise spans the EU Green Deal, PFAS regulation and accountability mechanisms, the Baltic Sea Action Plan, circular economy frameworks, ESG strategy, climate finance instruments, and EU nature restoration policy. She has applied this expertise both within enterprise operations and at intergovernmental advocacy level.

Her project and grant management experience covers EU structural funds, SIDA grant cycles, multi-stakeholder facilitation across government, NGO, and corporate sectors, and institutional fundraising. She has authored successful grant applications with logical frameworks and managed cross-sector partnerships across the Nordic region.

Barbora is professionally fluent in six languages: Swedish (professional proficiency), English (full professional proficiency), Czech (native), Slovak (native), and Danish and Norwegian (working knowledge), enabling her to operate across all Nordic countries without an interpreter.
